name: Sender + recipient address filter
description: Exercises match_sender_address_step and match_recipient_address_step in sequence (AND semantics via @stop chaining, same pattern as subject_and_message_id_filter.json): sender must match 'dispatch@partner-shipping\.com' AND at least one of To/Cc/Bcc/X-Original-To must match 'shipping.*@' (header='Any'). On match, saves every attachment under ./out/sender-recipient-filter/. Use with example-data/emails/sender_recipient_match_to.eml (matches via To: shippingops@ourcompany.com), sender_recipient_match_cc.eml (To doesn't match but Cc: shippingreports@ourcompany.com does - confirms the 'Any' option checks all four headers, not just To), or sender_recipient_nomatch.eml (sender matches but neither To nor Cc matches 'shipping.*@' - match_recipient_address_step stops the branch, nothing saved).
